hints.text: Complete this task using the familiar "move _ steps" and "repeat forever" commands.
hints.title: Program the ball sprite to move constantly

hints.text:
To complete this task, you need the command "if on edge, bounce," which also checks the condition! And it contains a mathematical formula for calculating the angle at which the ball turns.

But where do we put this command so that it always works?
hints.title: Program the ball so that it does not fly out of bounds

hints.text:
But we do not have this ready-made command. We need to program a check for the condition "if it touches the edge, it changes color."
You can change the color by changing the costume!
hints.title: Program the condition "if the ball touches the edge, it changes color"

tip.title: Перенести скрипт
tip.description: Скрипты у мячей очень похожи: они отличаются только указанием спрайтов, с которыми они сталкиваются. Если собрать скрипт для одного мяча, то его можно использовать как заготовку для других мячей. Для этого перенеси скрипт на изображение спрайта, как показано на анимации.

tips.title: Move the script
tips.description: The ball scripts are very similar: they differ only in specifying the sprites they are colliding with. If you assemble a script for one ball, it can then be used as a template for other balls. To do that, transfer the script to the sprite image, as shown in the animation.

presentation.text:
Study the game: you will need to create a similar one.
Use the mouse cursor to aim and shoot the crabs by clicking on the mouse.
The game consists of 2 stages: aiming and launching. Program the sprite to send messages to itself and split up the execution of the conditions using those messages!
